q: How do I check whether my installer's solar cells are on ALMM List-II?
title: How to check cells on ALMM List-II
short: Open MNRE's latest ALMM List-II revision and find the cell manufacturer, the plant location and the exact model. Each entry also gives the cell type, efficiency and wattage range, enlisted capacity and a validity period, so check the model is listed and still valid on your commissioning date.
audience: Factories and EPC buyers checking a solar quotation

ul: Manufacturer name and the address of the manufacturing facility.
Enlisted manufacturing capacity in MW a year.
Enlisted cell models, with cell type, for example N-type TOPCon or mono PERC, and size.
Average and range of cell efficiency and wattage, as claimed by the manufacturer.

ol: Get the cell manufacturer and cell model number from the module datasheet or the module maker.
Open the latest List-II revision on MNRE's website; the 12th revision was dated 8 October 2026.
Match manufacturer, plant location and model exactly; a different plant of the same company is a different entry.
Check your expected commissioning date falls inside the validity dates.
Save a copy of the page showing the entry with your project documents.

p: Revisions amend earlier entries as well as adding new ones, so use the latest revision, not an old download. Capacity shown in a revision replaces the earlier capacity for that unit; it is not added to it.

example.title: Example entry from the 12th revision (8 October 2026)
lines: Manufacturer: Gopin Semicon Private Limited, Kamrej, Surat, Gujarat
Capacity: 402 MW a year; cell: N-type TOPCon, G12R

senseible: Senseible stores your solar purchase documents with the installation record; checking ALMM entries stays with you and your installer.
